title: Health Insurance Check Karo - policy extraction
description: Output of the local pipeline for one uploaded health-insurance policy file. Rules: (1) every found fact carries evidence (page, clause, verbatim quote); (2) missing facts are 'not_mentioned', never guessed; (3) dates and arithmetic are computed by code; (4) general advice and illustrative numbers are labelled and kept apart from policy facts.

FieldStatus.description: found = stated in the document (evidence required). not_mentioned = looked for, absent: show 'not mentioned', never guess. ambiguous = conflicting or unclear text. not_applicable = does not apply to this product.

Confidence.description: 'verify' makes the UI show a 'check with your insurer' badge.

Origin.description: Keeps facts from the policy apart from calculations and generic advice.

Date.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Normalise DD/MM/YYYY from the source.

clause.description: Clause or code as printed, e.g. 'C.2.k', 'B-1.5', 'Excl04'.

Evidence.description: Where a fact comes from. The UI links every claim back to this.

SourcedString.description: Text value with status and evidence.

SourcedInteger.description: Whole number with status and evidence.

SourcedMoney.description: Rupee amount with status and evidence.

SourcedStringList.description: List of strings with status and evidence.

items.description: JSON Pointer to the input fields.

ComputedDate.description: A date calculated by code, never by the model. Always shown as 'approx. - verify'.

product_name.description: For product/add-on sheets: which product it describes.

Segment.description: One logical document inside the uploaded file. Insurers bundle several into one PDF.

redaction.description: Personal data removed before export or sharing.

structure.description: Per-person limit or one shared limit.

plus_benefit.description: Bonus added at renewal, e.g. 50% of base up to 100%.

combined_cover_stated_in_document.description: True only if the document itself states a combined total. Never add base+bonus+restore yourself; show components and say 'depends on policy terms'.

availability_in_product.description: What the generic Know-Your-Policy sheet says the product offers.

schedule_status.description: What YOUR schedule says. This is the one that matters.

user_has.description: Computed by reconciling the two. Drives the 'You have / You don't have' grid.

per_insured_status.description: What the personalised schedule says is still remaining for each person.

fresh_waiting_on_enhanced_sum_insured.description: If the sum insured is increased, waiting periods restart on the increase only. Always show as a caveat next to 'waived'.

exceptions.description: Cases where the exclusion does not apply.

overridden_by_benefit_ids.description: Benefits the user holds that cancel or reduce this exclusion.

arithmetic_check.description: Computed by code from the fields above, not by the model.

risk.description: Set by rules from the extracted fields; the model only writes the text.

example.description: Worked examples must be flagged as illustrative, never as facts from the policy.

general_guidance.description: Advice not taken from the policy. Origin is always general_guidance.
